faq.question: Q1. What is the organization name for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is being conducted by the Centre for Development of Advanced Computing (C-DAC), a premier R&D organization under the Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology.

faq.question: Q2. What is the post name for which applications are invited?
faq.answer: Applications are invited for the post of Consultant (IT and Network Engineer). This role involves specialized technical responsibilities within the organization's IT infrastructure.

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are available for the Consultant (IT and Network Engineer) post?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy available for the Consultant (IT and Network Engineer) position in this recruitment drive by C-DAC.

faq.question: Q4. What is the last date to apply for the C-DAC Consultant (IT and Network Engineer) Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date for candidates to submit their applications for the Consultant (IT and Network Engineer) post is 28 September 2026. Ensure your application reaches before this deadline.

faq.question: Q5. What is the mode of application for these posts?
faq.answer: Candidates are required to apply for the Consultant (IT and Network Engineer) posts through Email. Detailed instructions for email application are provided in the official notification.

faq.question: Q6. What is the maximum age limit to apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for applicants is 56 years. Age will be calculated as on 01 June 2026, as specified in the official notification.

faq.question: Q7. What are the essential educational qualifications required for the Consultant (IT and Network Engineer) post?
faq.answer: Candidates need a B.E/B-Tech or M.E/M.Tech/Post Graduate degree in relevant domains with 60% marks, or a Ph.D. (all but thesis), along with 8-10 years of relevant experience.

faq.question: Q8. Is there any application fee for the C-DAC Consultant (IT and Network Engineer) Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for the Consultant (IT and Network Engineer) posts. Applicants can apply free of cost.

faq.question: Q9. What is the selection process for the Consultant (IT and Network Engineer) position?
faq.answer: The selection process involves a Pre-Qualification Evaluation followed by an Interview, which may be conducted either offline or online, as decided by C-DAC.

faq.question: Q10. What is the job type for the Consultant (IT and Network Engineer) post at C-DAC?
faq.answer: The job type for the Consultant (IT and Network Engineer) position is contractual. This offers an opportunity to work with C-DAC on a contract basis in a government setup.
